notes: This repository is Cal.diy (the MIT community fork of Cal.com, README.md:37-49), package calcom-monorepo. Package manager Yarn Berry 4.12.0 (yarn.lock, packageManager yarn@4.12.0, yarnPath .yarn/releases, nodeLinker node-modules, root engines yarn >=4.12.0); apps/web/package.json still declares engines yarn 3.4.1 (stale). Node: README.md:73 says >=18.x and step 5 says 'nvm use', but there is no .nvmrc in the repo; CI yarn-install action defaults to Node v20.x and apps/web uses Next 16.4 (needs >=20.9), so 20 is recorded. 'yarn dx' = turbo run dx: first //#env-check:common and //#env-check:app-store (dotenv-checker against .env.example/.env.appStore.example; turbo declares .env and .env.appStore as outputs, so it creates/updates them and may prompt), then @calcom/prisma dx = db-setup = db-up (docker compose up -d in packages/prisma: postgres:18 on port 5450 matching .env.example DATABASE_URL) + db-deploy (prisma migrate deploy) + db-seed (test users, credentials in README.md:141-148), @calcom/emails dx (docker compose up mailhog on 1025/8025), @calcom/ui dx (build icons), and @calcom/web dx = yarn dev, so yarn dx also starts the app on http://localhost:3000. Decomposed: compose-up, prisma:migrate, seed, then dev. Afterwards 'yarn dev' (turbo dev for @calcom/web, also runs env-check). Alternative 'Manual setup' (README.md:191-261): own Postgres + DATABASE_URL, copy DATABASE_URL into .env.appStore, yarn workspace @calcom/prisma db-migrate, mailhog via docker run, yarn dev. Env values that must be filled: NEXTAUTH_SECRET, CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY (empty in .env.example); DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_DIRECT_URL default to the dx Postgres. Windows needs packages/prisma/.env symlink replaced (README.md:110-115). The root docker-compose.yml is the self-hosting stack, not the dev path. MailHog is recorded as mailpit. readmeCommands omit git clone / cd (fresh clone assumed) and the conditional 'nvm use' / 'nvm install && nvm use' (would fail: no .nvmrc).
